short_description: "Humiliation Dungeon Survivors" is a 2.5D survivor Roguelike game. Over a dozen cute girls of different professions need to pick up weapons to protect themselves and try to survive in this dangerous dungeon! If they are attacked by monsters, they will be ruthlessly humiliated!
